findings.summary: renew updates the lease by job_id without checking holder. After the sweeper releases A's expired lease and B claims the job, A's heartbeat renews B's lease and A keeps running: the job runs under two holders.
sweep defaults now to time.monotonic(), but expires_at is wall-clock time.time(). Monotonic seconds are far smaller, so no lease ever looks expired and dead workers' jobs are never requeued.
